statistical_scope: Three frozen target/wall parent strata; repeated noises within parent are dependent descriptive repeats, not six independent parents. No population posterior/calibration claim.
engineering_gate: position<=.1 AND shapeIoU>=.7 AND real_epsilon_relative_error<=.2; loss and mapL2 reported separately
boundary_air_defect: Historical blind_cavity is one boundary-connected air macrocell, not an enclosed internal cavity.

geometry_resolution_review.physical_forward_fidelity: Existing FINER_VALIDATION reports cover original normal and every registered r0 FullGN three-gate-positive parent. Those field differences are independent of rasterization checks here.
limits: Increasing the evaluation grid does not add data or refine FEM and never changes the saved continuous estimate.
Boundary distances use arclength samples, with reported step size; they are geometric estimates, not statistical resolution certificates.
No Rayleigh bound, calibrated posterior/coverage or uniform continuous inverse-resolution claim follows from these three point estimates.
Existing position<=.1 gate can be large compared with target radius; center/radius ratios explicitly expose that scale.

geometry_review_scope: Only r0 selected FullGN endpoints; no new threshold or branch selection; original gates retained
